plan.query_selection: fixed random sample without replacement from all SciFact test queries sorted by numeric ID

fused_fp32.precision: FP32 transformer fusion; document embeddings from original FP32 graph

fused_compact.precision: lossy fused INT8 projection/QAttention and UINT8 embedding weights; FP32 output vectors

plan.variant_order: rotate by the query's fixed sample position plus repetition; no concurrent model execution
plan.query_order: same fixed sample, cyclically rotated by repetition
plan.excluded: file/model loading, session construction, document embedding preparation, index construction, file hashing, warmup, metrics calculation and JSON serialization
plan.scope: query embedding + exact dense retrieval + cross-encoder reranking; no text generation, network, request queue or serving concurrency
plan.serialized_input_policy: query text omitted; per-text SHA256 uses original UTF8 bytes; full-input hash retains the original text-inclusive definition

score_definitions.retrieval_scores: float32 inner product of L2-normalized query/document vectors; cosine up to numeric rounding
score_definitions.reranker_logits: raw cross-encoder relevance logits; not probabilities and not directly comparable to dense cosine scores
score_definitions.retrieval_ties: Faiss IndexFlatIP output order; no cross-kernel bitwise ranking equivalence claimed
score_definitions.reranker_ties: stable descending logit sort, preserving dense candidate order for equal logits

latency_scope.measurement_unit: one complete query request with twenty reranked documents
latency_scope.p50_p95: empirical percentiles of individual request wall times, NumPy linear interpolation; repeated queries, warm serial process, no queue/network/concurrency
latency_scope.not_amortized: end-to-end seconds are measured per query, not transformer batch time divided by pair count
latency_scope.query_encoder_seconds: text validation, tokenization, ONNX inference, mask mean-pooling and L2 normalization at batch1
latency_scope.dense_search_seconds: exact Faiss IndexFlatIP top20 only, same backend for all variants
latency_scope.candidate_lookup_seconds: candidate index validation and document-text lookup
latency_scope.reranker_seconds: pair construction, tokenization, longest-first truncation, length sorting, padding, ONNX inference and logit restoration for20pairs at batch32
latency_scope.ranking_and_response_seconds: stable final ranking and Python response ID/score list construction
latency_scope.end_to_end_seconds: sum of all measured consecutive stages; excludes report metadata and JSON serialization
latency_scope.candidate_difference: variants may retrieve different documents; pipeline reranker-stage ratios include candidate content/length differences and are not fixed-input model speedups
latency_scope.tail_caveat: 48 observations from 16 distinct queries give a descriptive sample p95, not a production tail-latency guarantee

process_cpu_scope.clock: time.process_time_ns, measured beside time.perf_counter_ns at each stage boundary
process_cpu_scope.definition: aggregate user and system CPU time of this process, including all its threads
process_cpu_scope.interpretation: diagnostic alongside primary wall latency; can exceed wall time with multiple working threads; excludes time when the process is not running on a CPU
process_cpu_scope.limits: CPU/wall gaps can reflect scheduling or waiting and do not by themselves identify the cause; this is not hardware-cycle or energy measurement; both clocks add a small measurement overhead

quality_scope.fp32_original_control: query encoder, document encoder and reranker use original FP32 graphs; runtime ORT_ENABLE_ALL
quality_scope.fp32_fused_control: query encoder and reranker use fused FP32 graphs; cached corpus embeddings use the original FP32 encoder graph
quality_scope.fp32_full_test_reference: the separate source-FP32 quality report uses original graphs and NumPy dense ranking; it is not an exact full-test evaluation of this fused/Faiss pipeline
quality_scope.compact_control: query encoder, document encoder and reranker use the fused compact variants; dynamic quantization remains lossy and batch-dependent
quality_scope.matching_policy: one query encoder input; each query's20reranker pairs in its own length-sorted batch; max256including special tokens
quality_scope.full_test_quality: see separate 300-query quality artifacts; use the included 16-query metrics only as descriptive checks

primary_comparison.selection: lower end-to-end p50 across the two complete measured FP32 pipelines; no mixed encoder/reranker configuration and no per-query control selection

sample_quality.scope: descriptive quality of the fixed random latency sample only; no tuning or full-test quality claim
